m: शिथिलाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become relaxed, Bhartṛ.

a: शिथिलायते — Den. A. To become loose or flaccid; Bh. 3. 14.

m: शिथिली (ई), f. a kind of tawny-coloured ant (said to be a variety of the white ant), L.
शिथिली in comp. for शिथिल.
शिथिली—√ भू P. -भवति, to become loosened or slackened, be relaxed, slacken, Kāv.; Kathās.; to desist from (abl.), Mṛcch.
शिथिली—भूत mfn. loosened, relaxed, slackened, languid, Kathās.; Suśr.
शिथिली-शान्ति f. N. of wk.
शिथिली—करण n. the act of loosening, relaxing, impairing, weakening, Sarvad.
शिथिली—√ कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, to make loose, loosen, relax, slacken, weaken, impair, remit, abandon, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
शिथिली—कृत mfn. made loose, loosened, relaxed &c., ib.

m: शिथिल mf(आ)n. (collateral form of prec.) loose, slack, lax, relaxed, untied, flaccid, not rigid or compact, TS. &c. &c.
soft, pliant, supple, Pañcat.
unsteady, tremulous, MBh.
languid, inert, unenergetic, weak, feeble, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
careless in (loc.), R.
indistinct (as sound), L.
not rigidly observed, W.
loosely retained or possessed, abandoned, shaken off, ib.
शिथिल (अम्), n. a loose fastening, looseness, laxity, slowness, MW.
a partic. separation of the terms or members of a logical series, ib.
a: शिथिल — a. [श्लथ्-किलच् पृषो˚ Uṇ. 1. 53] 1 Loose, loosened, slackened, relaxed. --2 Untied, unfastened; Ś. 2. 6. --3 Severed, fallen from the stalk; अर्कस्योपरि शिथिलं च्युतमिव नवमल्लिकाकुसुमं Ś. 2. 8. --4 Languid, enfeebled, unnerved. --5 Weak, feeble; अशिथिलपरिरंभ U. 1. 24, 27 'fast or close embrace'. --6 Flaccid, flabby. --7 Dissolved. --8 Decayed. --9 Ineffective, futile, vain. --10 Inattentive, careless; Pt. 4. 116. --11 Loosely done, not strictly or rigidly performed. --12 Cast off, abandoned. --लं 1 Laxity, looseness. --2 Slowness. (शिथिलीकृ means {1} to loosen, unfasten, untie. {2} to relax, slacken. {3} to weaken, impair, enfeeble. --4 to give up, abandon; R. 2. 41. शिथिलीभू {1} to be slackened or relaxed. {2} to fall off from; Mk. 1. 13).

m: शिथिल—शक्ति mfn. impaired in strength or power, ib.
शिथिल—बल mfn. relaxed in strength, weakened, relaxed, ib.
शिथिलम् (अम्), ind. loosely, not firmly, Ragh.
शिथिल—ं-भाव See अ-श्˚.
शिथिल—पीडित mfn. loosely pressed or compressed (-ता f.), Suśr.
शिथिल—पीडित—ता f.
शिथिल—प्रयत्न mfn. one whose efforts are relaxed, MW.
शिथिल—समाधि mfn. having the attention drawn off or relaxed, Mālav.
शिथिल—ता f.
शिथिल—त्व n. looseness, laxity, relaxation, want of energy or care, indifference, languor (-तां-√ गम् or व्रज्, ‘to undergo indifference’, be neglected), Hariv.; Kāv.; Pañcat.
शिथिल—वसु mfn. having diminished wealth, MW.
shining with diminished rays, ib.
शिथिलय Nom. P. ˚यति, to loosen, make loose, relax, Śak.; Ā. ˚यते, to neglect, let pass, ib. (v.l.)

a: शिथिलयति — Den. P. 1 To relaxslacken, loosen, Ratn. 1. 14. --2 To give up, abandon; शिथिलय क्षणमात्रं बाष्पमोक्ष Ve. 5. --3 To lessen, allow to cool down; न सा इतोगतमनुरागं शिथिलयति V. 2.

m: शिथिलित mfn. loosed, loosened, slackened, relaxed, dissolved, made soft, Kāv.
a: शिथिलित — a. 1 Loosed. --2 Relaxed, loosened. --3 Dissolved.

m: शिथिलित—ज्य mfn. (a bow) whose string has been relaxed, Kathās.
शिथिलित—मृणाल mfn. (an armlet formed) of lotus-fibres hanging loose, Śak.
शिथिर mf(आ)n. (for शृथिर fr. √ श्रथ्) loose, lax, slack, flexible pliant, soft, RV.; AV.; Br.
